summary: Completed Goal C documentation and integration verification for the ArrTags provider inventory cache. Reconciled docs/architecture.md sections 8 and 12, docs/data-model.md section 6, the ArrInventoryCache/ArrInventoryCacheEntry/ArrInventoryCacheState XML docs, ADR-018 Consequences, README.md, PLANS.md, docs/project-status.md, docs/changelog.md, docs/implementation-readiness.md, and docs/limitations.md with the shipped behavior. Corrected the previously implied failure-driven inventory last-known-good retention (ArrInventoryCacheEntry.WithFailure and LastError have no production caller; TryStore is never called with lastError in production) so the docs now state that a stored observation set is served as bounded last-known-good through the TTL second half (ArrInventoryCacheState.Stale is the TTL second-half state produced by EvaluateState and served by TryGet, not a failure marker), that a library read failure during a population caches nothing and returns the bounded failure, and that a failed bulk/sub-read falls back to the unchanged direct read. Recorded docs/limitations.md F1 as resolved at the integration-test level with the remaining bounds stated honestly (Sonarr O(series) per window and sparse-window amplification, eager whole-library population on a miss, size-bound rejection via the direct read, library-read-failure blast radius vs sub-read fallback, whole-cache clear on a full reconciliation, per-connection single-flight coalescing present), and noted the live pinned-host confirmation remains owned by task 14.3. Added ADR-018 Consequences clauses for the Sonarr O(series) bound, the sparse-window amplification, and the failure blast radius. Annotated the task 11.1 changelog sentence as superseded by task 11.4 and reworded the two Phase 7 open-items headers to note the v1.1-promoted bullets are closed. Added three integration tests to ProviderInventoryCacheIntegrationTests (25 total): a composed real-reader/real-cache/real-MetadataReconciliationProcessor Radarr library-read failure on a cache miss fails the window, caches nothing, and retains the per-item bounded last-known-good metadata state as explicit stale with unchanged fingerprint/expiresAt/staleUntil; a Radarr bulk moviefile?movieId= failure falls back to the per-record direct read; and a Sonarr per-series /episode?seriesId= failure for a non-matched series falls back to the direct read for the matched series. No production behavior changed (XML documentation only).

known_limitations: F1 is resolved at the integration-test level only; the live pinned-host confirmation is owned by task 14.3 and was not performed here (no live Jellyfin/Sonarr/Radarr instance).

Gate 11 is not claimed met: the phase review and the v1.1.0-phase11 tag are the orchestrator/reviewer's remaining steps. All four Phase 11 acceptance criteria are met at the integration-test level and their checkboxes are marked accordingly.

The documented remaining behavior bounds are: Sonarr per-series episode reads are O(series) per window (no whole-library episode endpoint); a sparse webhook/single-item invalidation window removes the whole connection inventory and repopulates the whole library (which can exceed the pre-11.2 per-item read on a large Sonarr library); cache population is eager whole-library on a miss; an over-bound observation set is not cached and falls back to the direct read; a library read failure fails the whole window while a sub-read failure falls back to the direct read; a full-reconciliation clear removes every cached connection entry; and concurrent cold readers coalesce through the per-connection single-flight gate.

Per the 'do not rewrite historical records' rule, the point-in-time task 11.1/11.2/11.3 status blocks in PLANS.md and the historical task 11.1/11.2 changelog entries still contain their original 'F1 is not yet resolved' / 'a provider failure keeps...' wording; the task 11.1 changelog sentence is annotated as superseded by task 11.4, and the current-state surfaces (Project Status, milestone row 11, docs/project-status.md, docs/limitations.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/data-model.md, docs/decisions.md, README.md, docs/implementation-readiness.md) are reconciled.
